image-order rendering is feasible on message-passing machines, and that the techniques we have used are applicable to a wide range of image-order algorithms.
we have demonstrated the feasibility of using image-space parallelism and message-passing multicores for real-time volume rendering of large data sets.

image-space task parallelization can be an effective way to exploit the parallelism inherent in image-order rendering algorithms.
